title: Compound Dihuang Granule Changes Gut Microbiota of MPTP-Induced Parkinson's Disease Mice via Inhibiting TLR4/NF-kappaB Signaling.
authors: He, Zhu-Qing; Huan, Peng-Fei; Wang, Li; He, Jian-Cheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方地黄颗粒通过TLR4/NF-kB通路改善帕金森病小鼠肠道菌群，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Intestinal microbiota was connected to Parkinson's Disease (PD) pathology. The ancient Chinese medication for PD is Compound Dihuang Granule (CDG), and we found a neuroprotective function in treating the constipation of PD patients. Nevertheless, the mechanism of action still needs to be clarified. We predicted the probable targets of CDG against PD through Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) network pharmacology and verified the analysis through animal experiments in vivo. The protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis screened PD-related genes, including Toll-like receptor 4(TLR4), TANK-binding kinase 1(TBK1), Nuclear Factor- Kappa B (NF-kappaB), and Tumor necrosis factor (TNF). Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analyses proved that the NF-kappaB and toll-like receptor signaling pathways serve a key function in CDG therapy of PD. Molecular docking analysis demonstrated that CDG strongly connected to TLR4/NF-kappaB. Experiments findings indicated that CDG improved the damage of dopaminergic neurons and gut microbial dysbiosis, ameliorated motor impairments, and suppressed the PD-associated inflammation and oxidative stress in mice induced by 1-methyl-4-phenyl-1,2,3,6-tetrahy dropyridine (MPTP). CDG suppressed the inflammatory proteins in the colon and protected the intestinal barrier. Overall, CDG improved gut microbial in PD by blocking the pathway of TLR4/NF-kappaB.
abstract_zh: 肠道微生物群与帕金森病（Parkinson's Disease, PD）病理相关。古代中药复方地黄颗粒（Compound Dihuang Granule, CDG）用于治疗PD，我们发现其在治疗PD患者便秘方面具有神经保护功能。然而，其作用机制仍需阐明。我们通过中药（Traditional Chinese medicine, TCM）网络药理学预测了CDG抗PD的可能靶点，并通过体内动物实验验证了分析结果。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络分析筛选出PD相关基因，包括Toll样受体4（Toll-like receptor 4, TLR4）、TANK结合激酶1（TANK-binding kinase 1, TBK1）、核因子-κB（Nuclear Factor- Kappa B, NF-kappaB）和肿瘤坏死因子（Tumor necrosis factor, TNF）。基因本体论（Gene Ontology, GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）分析证明，NF-kappaB和Toll样受体信号通路在CDG治疗PD中发挥关键作用。分子对接分析表明，CDG与TLR4/NF-kappaB强烈结合。实验结果表明，CDG改善了1-甲基-4-苯基-1,2,3,6-四氢吡啶（1-methyl-4-phenyl-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine, MPTP）诱导的小鼠中多巴胺能神经元损伤和肠道微生物失调，改善了运动障碍，并抑制了PD相关炎症和氧化应激。CDG抑制了结肠中的炎症蛋白，并保护了肠道屏障。总体而言，CDG通过阻断TLR4/NF-kappaB通路改善了PD中的肠道微生物。
